title: DP04 versioned trading-calendar evidence envelope
description: Envelope contract for DP04 calendar evidence documents (work-order DP04-calendar.md H04.1/H04.2; data-quality contract Q05/D06). The authoritative validator is src/ak_trading/datapipeline/calendar.py::calendar_evidence_document_from_mapping - this schema mirrors it and must not drift (tests cross-check the required-field sets). Nothing here authorizes natural-day, weekday or fixed-20:00 inference; every calendar fact must arrive in an evidence document.

evidence_version.description: Append-only version label; one version is exactly one document byte-wise (binding conflicts are hard errors).

source_id.description: Data-source channel identity (no accounts, no secrets).

synthetic_marker.description: REQUIRED (and must contain 'SYNTHETIC') when data_origin is SYNTHETIC or SCENARIO; forbidden otherwise. Covered by document_sha256 (finding F16).

source_symbols.description: Exact source_symbol matches (e.g. instrument lifecycle documents).

applicability.description: At least one of the three arrays must be non-empty.

coverage.description: PARTIAL_DAYS_LISTED (default): unlisted time inside the validity domain is UNKNOWN. COMPLETE_IN_VALIDITY_DOMAIN: the grid enumerates every session in the window, so non-session time is NO_TRADING_EVIDENCED by enumeration.

pit_basis.description: OBTAINED_AT requires obtained_at_nano (possession proof; informs as_of >= obtained_at only). UNKNOWN forbids obtained_at_nano and lets the document inform NO query (H04.6).

evidence_reference.description: Where the evidence came from; REQUIRED for REAL_SOURCE.

evidence_text_sha256.description: Hash of the underlying evidence text; REQUIRED for REAL_SOURCE.

review_status.description: Carried verbatim (never laundered), e.g. the DP00 2026 anchor is review_required.

sessions.description: SESSION_GRID only: per trading-day session segments with the exchange trading-day label retained verbatim (H04.4).

closed_dates.description: Exchange-level closed civil dates. Required non-empty for EXCHANGE_CLOSED_DATES.

instrument_windows.description: Listing/delisting validity windows per exact source_symbol (H04.4).

nanoString.description: Integer nanoseconds within signed int64; strings of digits are the canonical JSON form (no float round-trip).
